info.title: Apache Iggy HTTP API
info.description: REST API of the Apache Iggy server. Most routes need a bearer credential: either an access token from a login or refresh route, or a raw personal access token. Names and numeric IDs are both accepted wherever a path takes a stream, topic, consumer group, user or consumer. In a cluster, a follower forwards control plane writes to the primary. The web UI routes under `/ui` are not described here.

get.description: Unauthenticated. The `Iggy-View` and `Iggy-Applied-Op` headers are never set on this route.

200.description: The server is up. The body is the text `pong`.
Server and storage statistics.

get.summary: Describe the option catalogue for a resource
get.description: Any authenticated user may call this route.

200.description: Every option key the scope accepts.
A ZIP archive sent as an attachment named `iggy_snapshot_<YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS>.zip`.

get.description: Registered only when `http.metrics.enabled` is true, at the path set by `http.metrics.endpoint`. `/metrics` is the default in the shipped `config.toml`. Any authenticated user may scrape.

200.description: Metrics in the Prometheus text exposition format.

get.description: Any authenticated user may call this route. Node addresses are chosen for the caller's network when the cluster config has matching address selectors.

200.description: The cluster name and its nodes.
Every connected client across all shards.
The client and its consumer group memberships.

post.summary: Log in with a username and password
post.description: Unauthenticated. Wrong credentials and an inactive user are answered with 400. Answers 503 if the node has not finished replaying its log after a restart.

200.description: An access token for the user.

post.description: Unauthenticated. The current access token is sent in the body. The presented token is not revoked and stays valid until it expires. Tokens from trusted external issuers cannot be refreshed.

200.description: A new access token for the same user.

delete.description: Ends the server-side session for the presented credential. The bearer token itself is not revoked and stays valid until it expires.

200.description: Every user.
The created user.

get.description: Reading your own user (by `me`, your ID or your username) needs no permission. Reading another user requires `read_users` or `manage_users`.

200.description: The user and its permissions.

put.description: Changes the username, the status, or both. Requires the `manage_users` permission.
A wrong current password is answered with 400.

post.summary: Log in with a personal access token
post.description: Unauthenticated. An unknown or expired token is answered with 401.

200.description: An access token for the token's owner.

get.description: Lists only the caller's own tokens.

200.description: The caller's tokens. The secrets are never returned.

post.description: Creates a token for the caller.

200.description: The raw token. It is returned only once.

delete.description: Deletes one of the caller's own tokens.

200.description: Every stream.
The created stream. The server assigns its ID.
The stream and its topics.
Every topic in the stream.
The created topic. The server assigns its ID.
The topic and its partitions.
The partitions were added. The response has no body.

parameters.name: partitions_count
parameters.description: Number of partitions to remove, from 1 to 1000.

parameters.name: segments_count
parameters.description: Number of the oldest sealed segments to delete.

200.description: Every consumer group in the topic.
The created consumer group. The server assigns its ID.
The consumer group and its members.

get.description: Answers 404 when no offset has been stored for the consumer.

parameters.name: consumer_id
parameters.description: Consumer ID or name. Defaults to 1. HTTP always uses a regular consumer, never a consumer group.

200.description: The stored and current offsets.

put.description: Waits for the partition's quorum commit before answering.

delete.description: Answers 404 when no offset has been stored for the consumer.

get.description: Requires the `poll_messages` permission for the topic. A poll that the server fences as a stale consumer group assignment is answered with 200 and an empty batch.

parameters.name: consumer_id
parameters.description: Consumer ID or name. Defaults to 1. HTTP always uses a regular consumer, never a consumer group.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Where to start polling. Defaults to `offset`. The single letters `o`, `t`, `f`, `l` and `n` are also accepted.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Offset, or timestamp in microseconds, for the `offset` and `timestamp` kinds. Defaults to 0.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Maximum number of messages to return. Defaults to 10.

parameters.name: auto_commit
parameters.description: Store the consumer offset after polling. The offset may advance before the response arrives, and a successful response does not confirm the commit.

200.description: The polled messages.

post.description: Requires the `send_messages` permission for the topic.

parameters.name: ack
parameters.description: `replicated` waits for the quorum commit and answers 201. `none` answers 202 as soon as the batch is dispatched.

201.description: The batch was committed. The body lists where it landed.

202.description: The batch was accepted for dispatch. Commit was not awaited. The response has no body.

bearerAuth.description: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The token is an access token from `POST /users/login`, `POST /personal-access-tokens/login` or `POST /users/refresh-token`, or a raw personal access token. The server tries it as a JWT first and then as a personal access token. Tokens from configured trusted external issuers are also accepted.

UserIdOrMe.name: user_id
UserIdOrMe.description: User ID or username, or `me` for the caller. A user named `me` can still be read by ID.

ConsumerId.name: consumer_id
ConsumerId.description: Consumer ID or name. HTTP always uses a regular consumer, never a consumer group.

PatName.name: name
PatName.description: Name of the personal access token.

Consistency.name: consistency
Consistency.description: `serializable` reads from this node's local state, which may lag the primary. `linearizable` reads from the primary: a follower redirects with 307 when it can resolve the primary's address, and answers 503 otherwise. Unknown values are rejected with 400.

IggyView.description: Current consensus view number. Set on success and redirect responses when the node runs consensus. Never set on errors or on `/ping`.

IggyAppliedOp.description: Metadata operation number the serving node has applied. Set on success and redirect responses. Never set on errors or on `/ping`.

IggyDurabilityCommitted.description: Durability the commit achieved under the topic's message policy.

IggyDurabilityNone.description: Always `none`: the batch was dispatched but its commit was not awaited.

Location.description: URL of the same request on the primary.

ContentDisposition.description: Marks the response as a file download.

TemporaryRedirect.description: Only for `consistency=linearizable` on a follower. Repeat the request against the primary at `Location`.

BadRequest.description: The request was rejected: an invalid identifier, a failed validation, or a business error such as a duplicate name. A path or query string that cannot be parsed, or malformed JSON, is answered with a plain text body instead.

Unauthenticated.description: The bearer credential is missing, invalid or expired.

Forbidden.description: The caller lacks the permission this route needs.

SessionConflict.description: The server session ID minted for this credential is owned by another user. Retrying will not help.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The body is larger than `http.max_request_size`. The body is plain text, or JSON with code `payload_too_large` when the node was forwarding the request. The connection is closed on HTTP/1.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: The request has no `Content-Type: application/json` header.

UnprocessableEntity.description: The JSON body does not match the expected shape.

TooManyRequests.description: This session already has too many writes in flight. Wait for them to finish, then retry.

BadGateway.description: The node forwarded the request to the primary and the forward failed after sending. The outcome is unknown.

ServiceUnavailable.description: A temporary condition, such as no caught-up primary, a node still recovering, or a busy node. Safe to retry after `Retry-After`.

GatewayTimeout.description: No reply arrived in time. For writes the outcome is unknown and the write may still commit.

Identifier.description: A numeric ID or a name, 1 to 255 bytes long. A value that parses as an unsigned 32-bit integer is used as a numeric ID. Anything else is used as a name, so a resource whose name is all digits can only be addressed by its ID.

ErrorResponse.description: Error body returned by every route.

id.description: Iggy error code, or the HTTP status code for errors raised by the HTTP layer itself.

code.description: Error name in snake case, for example `stream_id_not_found` or `not_found`.

field.description: Request field the error relates to, when known.

ByteSize.description: Byte size as a string with a unit, for example `0 B`, `1 KiB` or `1.234 KB`.

Expiry.description: Expiry in microseconds. 0 means the server default and 18446744073709551615 (the largest unsigned 64-bit value) means never expire.

MaxTopicSize.description: Maximum topic size in bytes. 0 means the server default and 18446744073709551615 (the largest unsigned 64-bit value) means unlimited.

CompressionAlgorithm.description: Compression algorithm. Input is matched without regard to case.

value.description: Value in the same string form a create request takes.

explicit.description: True when the value was set by a client rather than defaulted.

kind.description: Value type the server stores the option as.

default_value.description: Default value as raw bytes in the encoding of `kind`. Empty when the key has no default.

access_token.description: Always set by the login and refresh routes.

token.description: Access token (JWT) to send as a bearer token.

expiry.description: Expiry time in seconds since the Unix epoch.

version.description: Client version. Accepted but not used by the HTTP login.

context.description: Client context. Accepted but not used by the HTTP login.

token.description: A current, unexpired access token issued by this server.
Raw token. Store it securely: it cannot be retrieved again.

expiry_at.description: Expiry time, or null if the token never expires.

GlobalPermissions.description: Permissions that apply to every stream.

StreamPermissions.description: Permissions for one stream and its topics.

topics.description: Per-topic permissions keyed by numeric topic ID.

streams.description: Per-stream permissions keyed by numeric stream ID.

options.description: Resource options keyed by option name.
Resource options keyed by option name.

permissions.description: Permissions. Omit or send null for none.

username.description: New username, 3 to 50 bytes. Omit to keep the current one.

status.description: New status. Omit to keep the current one.

options.description: User options to change. No user option can be changed yet, so any key is rejected.

permissions.description: New permissions. Omit or send null to remove all permissions.

options.description: Resource options keyed by option name.
Resource options keyed by option name.

name.description: Unique stream name, up to 255 bytes.
New stream name, up to 255 bytes.

options.description: Stream options to change. No stream option can be changed yet, so any key is rejected.
Resource options keyed by option name.
Resource options keyed by option name.

Further topic options as strings, parsed with the same rules as the server config. Accepted keys: `compression_algorithm`, `message_expiry`, `max_topic_size`, `segment_size`, `durability`, `consumer_offset_durability`, `messages_required_to_save`, `size_of_messages_required_to_save` and `preallocate_segments`. Unknown keys are rejected. `GET /options/topic` describes each key.

compression_algorithm.description: Omit to keep the current value.

message_expiry.description: Omit to keep the current value.

max_topic_size.description: Omit to keep the current value.

options.description: Topic options to change. Only `compression_algorithm`, `message_expiry` and `max_topic_size` are accepted. Keys that are not sent keep their current values.

partitions_count.description: Number of partitions to add, from 1 to 1000.

ConsumerId.description: Consumer ID as a number, or an ID or name as a string. Defaults to 1.

snapshot_types.description: What to include in the archive.

ip.description: Address for the caller to connect to.

kind.description: `balanced` picks a partition by round robin. `partition_id` uses the partition in `value`. `messages_key` hashes `value` to pick a partition.

value.description: Base64 bytes, at most 255 before encoding. For `partition_id`, the partition ID as 4 little-endian bytes. For `messages_key`, the key. May be empty only for `balanced`.

HeaderField.description: A typed header key or value.

value.description: Base64 of the value bytes. Numbers are little-endian.

oneOf.description: Raw header bytes that could not be decoded as entries, such as client-side encrypted headers.
Decimal 128-bit ID, or 32 hex digits with optional dashes (UUID form).
Raw header bytes, for example client-side encrypted headers.

SendMessages.description: Only `partitioning` and `messages` are accepted. Other fields are rejected.

confirmations.description: One entry per partition the batch landed in. Empty when the commit reported no offsets.

base_offset.description: Offset of the first message of the batch in the partition.

partition_id.description: Partition the messages came from. An empty batch may carry a sentinel value instead.

user_headers.description: User headers. An empty array when the message has none.

id.description: Message ID, an unsigned 128-bit integer written as a JSON number.
